facts.fact: The National Bureau of Statistics released anonymised v1.0 microdata of the Nigeria Labour Force Survey Q1 2024 (8,836 households in 36 states and the FCT, collected 2024-01-31 to 2024-03-20), version dated 2024-04-15.

NGA.note: Only disability questions in a labour force survey; nothing on accessible information or digital services.
No ISIC section J employment share or youth unemployment figure stated.
Only a statistical labour-market standard is mentioned; nothing on IT or data standards bodies or adoption.
Nothing on local government office connection.

facts.fact: The catalogue entry says respondent confidentiality is protected by the Statistics Act 2007, published in the Official Gazette No. 60 vol. 94 of 11 June 2007, with section 27 setting data producers' obligation to release anonymised microdata.
